summary: tslint-folder-schema preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` prefers a system `bun` if available, otherwise downloads a pinned Bun runtime archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/`, unzips it, sets it executable, and uses it to `execFileSync` a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle with string-array obfuscation (large mixed int/string constant array plus a rotation function) and no readable strings. Fetching a Bun runtime to execute a large opaque bundle at install time is not required by the package's advertised purpose (a TSLint folder-schema rule); the readable `lib/folderSchemaRule.js` mirrors the public API of `servicetitan/folder-lint` and serves as bait while the preinstall dropper runs the obfuscated payload under Bun, hidden from Node-only static review. Package metadata claims `homepage: github.com/servicetitan/folder-lint` but the publisher is a personal Gmail (`aegaeon51@gmail.com`), consistent with impersonation of a corporate OSS project.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
